One comment

Plum Creek

This tune is the opening of Metamora’s eponymous album from 1985. The band, Grey Larsen, Malcolm Dalglish, and Pete Sutherland wrote some exquisite music, and all are, or were, world class ITM players. To the best of my recollection, this tune was written by Grey Larsen for concertina, but works well on any instrument. I have made a few alterations to the original for ease of playing on solo guitar.
